name: Appar
reason: title_or_honorific: Appar means "father" and is an affectionate title for Tirunavukkarasar, not his given name or a name families give.

name: Basava
reason: Common given name (Basavaraj etc.); meaning clarified.

fix.meaning_en: Bull (Nandi); name of the 12th-century Lingayat reformer Basavanna.

name: Chandidas
reason: Used as a given name; meaning made explicit.

fix.meaning_en: Servant of Chandi (the goddess Durga); name of the medieval Bengali poet.

name: Chokha
reason: epithet_not_given_name: Short form of Chokhamela (a saint's byname); not used as a given name.

name: Dnyandev
reason: Real given name; meaning slightly clarified.

fix.meaning_en: Lord of knowledge (jnana + deva); name of the saint Dnyaneshwar.

name: Jalaram
reason: "Rama of the waters" was an invented gloss.

fix.meaning_en: Name of the Gujarati saint Jalaram Bapa; from jala (water) and Rama, exact etymology uncertain.
Victory (jaya) and sacred ford (tirtha); name of the Madhva scholar-saint.

name: Madhavdev
reason: Used as a given name; meaning clarified.

fix.meaning_en: Divine Madhava (Krishna); name of the Assamese saint Madhavadeva.

name: Manikkavasagar
reason: epithet_not_given_name: Manikkavacakar is a title ("of ruby words") for the saint Vatavurar; overlong and not a given name.

name: Muthuswami
reason: Genuine given name, correct form and meaning.

name: Nammazhwar
reason: epithet_not_given_name: "Our own Alvar" is an honorific for the saint Maran/Satakopan; not a given name.

name: Purandaradasa
reason: obscure_figure: Full historical dasa-name of a composer; not a name families give (Purandar/Dasa are the usable forms).

fix.meaning_en: Servant of Rama (Telugu form of Ramadas); also the name of the devotee Bhadrachala Ramadasu.
Servant of Ravi (the sun); name of the saint-poet Ravidas (Raidas), etymology of the saint's name uncertain.

name: Sambandar
reason: epithet_not_given_name: Byname of the child-saint Tirugnanasambandar; Devanagari सम्बन्दर does not match iast campantar; not a given name.

name: Sankaradeva
reason: Used as given name (Sankardev); meaning clarified.

fix.meaning_en: Divine Shankara (Shiva); name of the Assamese saint Srimanta Sankardev.

name: Sundarar
reason: title_or_honorific: Honorific -ar form used for the Nayanar saint; the given name is Sundar/Sundaramurti.

name: Swaminarayan
reason: deity_not_for_person: Name of the deified founder/God worshipped by a sect; not appropriate as a child's name.
